description: Model A calibration: weighted observed vs mean predicted fatal share by weighted decile of predicted fatal risk, with design-based confidence intervals
population: CRSS police-reported crashes 2016-2024 with known maximum severity
method: Model A (published specification) fitted values; deciles hold 1/10 of the total weight; observed and predicted shares are weighted means (logit CIs); difference and ratio linearised; predictions treated as fixed (in-sample), so CIs omit model-fit variability
